documented_behavior_paraphrased: ControlMaster=no sessions still reuse a matching configured ControlPath.
When the control socket is unavailable, the ordinary connection path uses ProxyCommand.
The first specified ProxyCommand or ProxyJump setting prevents a later competing setting from taking effect.
Command-line options take precedence over the later user configuration.
conclusion_kind: inference from installed documented behavior and the actual alias configuration
conclusion: Retain ControlMaster=no, ProxyCommand=false and BatchMode=yes on the single refresh query. The existing socket is reused; without it, false supplies no network transport, so the query fails before remote authentication.
change: Remove all explicit ssh -O checks from periodic refreshes. Keep them only in the separate at-most-hourly resource review. Record master_check.performed=false and do not claim the master was separately verified.
